g.text: ElevenLabs API key saved · settings on this computer
On a project, 🎙 Meet joins your meeting: the assistant hears the meeting app, speaks through a virtual microphone, and looks up the project's conversations, pull
requests, findings and issues. It only reads: it never starts, messages, merges or closes anything.
Saved — type a new key to replace it
Act independently: take part on my behalf and answer what is asked of me · off
Introduce itself as my AI assistant when it joins · on
Otherwise it speaks only when you or it are addressed by a wake word, or when you choose “Answer now”.
✓ CABLE Input (VB-Audio Virtual Cable) is installed. In your meeting app, pick “CABLE Output” as the microphone and keep your usual speakers. …
Gmail and Outlook. Read-only until you enable mail actions.
Sign-in opens in the browser. Tokens stay on the server.
[Disable] [Sync days] [Sign in again] [Enable mail actions] [Sync now] [Disconnect]
Enable mail actions requests permission to send and move mail, including moving messages to trash. Approve access in your provider's sign-in window.
Commands, environment and loopback endpoints run on the core machine. Core mounts tools into Claude/Codex turns; changes apply on their next turn.
Keep omits secrets from the save. Replace sends the whole set as a JSON object, including unchanged entries. Clear sends an empty object. An Authorization header
bypasses OAuth. Switching transport removes the other transport's secrets on core.
Settings · MCP server › Advanced OAuth tab
Keep omits the client secret. Replace sends the new value as typed. Clear sends an empty string.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
'This computer' always comes first in the sidebar and needs no Admin token. The Mail section appears only when the server advertises the mail account route and the token is Admin.

Meeting assistant has no tabs. 🗑 (remove the ElevenLabs key) appears only when a key is saved. Without VB-Cable, the Virtual microphone section shows a notice and 'Check again'. 'Remove the OpenAI key' appears only if an old key is

Mail: each account card's buttons appear only when their routes exist. Connect Gmail / Connect Outlook appear only for providers the server has configured. Sync days and Finish sign-in open text dialogs.

MCP buttons that toggle (Transport, Enabled, All/Selected repositories, Redirect, secret modes) are bordered buttons whose labels change, not real switches. The repository list uses [x] / [ ] buttons. In stdio mode the fields are
'Command on the core machine', 'Arguments (JSON array; …)', 'Environment: …' and 'Replacement environment (JSON object)'.
There is no settings page in the Windows client for Slack workspaces, Devices & tokens, or Server administration (features.json marks them 'none' for windows), so no frames are drawn for them.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
